title: Cache Service Overview
text: The cache service stores frequently accessed data in memory and falls back to object storage when cache misses happen.

title: Cache Service Overview
text: The cache service stores hot data in memory and falls back to object storage on cache misses to reduce latency.

title: Prefetch Policy
text: Prefetch is enabled for repeated sessions and can reduce p95 latency when requests share semantic similarity.

title: Rate Limits
text: The control API is rate-limited to 100 requests per minute per client token.

title: Return Policy
text: Items can be returned within 30 days after delivery when they are in resellable condition.

title: Return Policy
text: Items can be returned within 21 days after delivery when they are in resellable condition.

title: Refund Methods
text: Card purchases are refunded to the original card. Gift card purchases are refunded as store credit.

title: Exchange Rules
text: Exchanges are allowed only for active catalog SKUs and unavailable SKUs require a refund fallback.

title: Invoice Terms
text: Net payment terms are 30 days from invoice issue date for enterprise customers.

title: Discount Policy
text: Volume discounts apply from 100 seats and above with a maximum discount cap of 18 percent.

title: Credit Notes
text: Credit notes are generated only after refund approval and are linked to the original invoice id.

title: Data Retention Notice
text: Operational logs must be retained for 180 days and then archived for long-term storage.

title: Access Control
text: Privileged actions require two-factor authentication and role approval for production changes.

title: Incident Reporting
text: Security incidents must be reported within 24 hours of detection to the oversight team.

title: Object Storage Latency
text: Object storage reads are slower than in-memory reads, so metadata filters are used to avoid unnecessary lookups.

title: Semantic Cache
text: Semantic cache hit rate improves when prompts from related sessions reuse similar phrasing and intent.

title: Damaged Items
text: Damaged items are eligible for full refund including shipping if damage is verified in support workflow.

title: Shipping Charges
text: Standard shipping charges are non-refundable except for damaged or incorrect item deliveries.

title: Tax Handling
text: Refund tax treatment follows the original invoice jurisdiction and is recalculated for partial refunds.

title: Encryption Policy
text: All customer data at rest must use AES-256 encryption and key rotation every 90 days.

title: KV Cache Architecture
text: The KV cache stores attention key-value pairs produced during LLM inference and reuses them across requests sharing a common prefix to avoid recomputation.

title: KV Cache Eviction
text: KV cache blocks are evicted from GPU memory under memory pressure using LRU or prefix-reuse eviction policies before being offloaded to CPU RAM or object storage.

title: Bloom Filter Usage
text: A Bloom filter provides O(1) existence checks for object identifiers, eliminating unnecessary storage lookups for cold misses.

title: Bloom Filter False Positives
text: Bloom filter false positive rate is configurable at construction time; typical deployments use fp_rate=0.01 with expected_items=100000.

title: HNSW Semantic Index
text: The HNSW index enables approximate nearest-neighbour search over embedding vectors in sub-linear time and is used for semantic cache lookups.

title: HNSW Index Rebuild
text: On startup the HNSW index is rebuilt from stored embeddings in the metadata store when the service resumes after a restart.

title: Prefix Tree Matching
text: The prefix tree stores token sequences from cached KV blocks and enables longest-prefix-match queries in O(k) time where k is the token count.

title: Agent Workflow Types
text: Four agentic workflow patterns are supported: ReAct, multi-agent, RAG-agent, and tool-agent. Each pattern has different step graphs and KV sharing characteristics.

title: Agent Step Graph
text: The agent step graph tracks parent-child relationships between workflow steps and is used by the workflow-aware eviction policy to retain steps that are likely referenced by future steps.

title: Tool Latency Estimator
text: The tool latency estimator uses an exponential moving average of observed call durations to predict whether a tool-call pause is long enough to justify evicting KV blocks from GPU memory.

title: Tool Call Pause Threshold
text: When the estimated tool latency exceeds the configured eviction threshold, the system proactively offloads KV blocks to L3 storage to free GPU memory for other requests.

title: Retention Policy TTL
text: The AgentTTLPolicy computes per-object time-to-live values based on workflow status, tool latency estimates, and the object consistency class.

title: Consistency Classes
text: Objects can be classified as IMMUTABLE, TTL, SOURCE_VERSIONED, WRITE_THROUGH, or WRITE_BACK. Immutable objects are never evicted before their explicit deletion.

title: gRPC API Surface
text: The L3Service exposes put, get, delete, list, and prefetch_batch RPCs over gRPC. Client stubs are generated from the l3store.proto schema.

title: gRPC Client Wrapper
text: The synchronous L3Client wraps the generated gRPC stub and translates Python dataclasses to protobuf messages and back.

title: Storage Backend Abstraction
text: All storage operations are routed through the StorageBackend interface, which is implemented by S3Backend for production and MemoryBackend for tests and local development.

title: Atomic Two-Phase Write
text: Each put operation writes object metadata first and then data bytes, giving a consistent view where a successful metadata write always implies retrievable data.

title: RAG Object Caching
text: RAG objects cache retrieved document chunks together with their embedding vectors so that identical retrieval queries bypass the vector store on subsequent requests.

title: RAG Semantic Deduplication
text: When two retrieval queries produce embeddings within the similarity threshold, the cached result for the earlier query is returned without a second retrieval call.

title: Plan Cache
text: PlanCacheEntry stores the tool sequence and constraints associated with a high-level task goal. Repeated identical goals reuse the cached plan instead of replanning.

title: Revenue Recognition
text: SaaS subscription revenue is recognised ratably over the contract term in accordance with ASC 606.

title: Deferred Revenue
text: Payments received in advance of service delivery are classified as deferred revenue and released to income monthly.

title: Chargeback Policy
text: Disputed charges trigger an automatic hold on the associated order until the bank investigation is resolved, typically within 45 business days.

title: Chargeback Resolution
text: Resolved chargebacks in the merchant's favour release the order hold and restore the customer's account standing without requiring manual intervention.

title: Currency Conversion
text: Multi-currency orders are settled in the customer's billing currency at the exchange rate locked at checkout time.

title: FX Rate Lock
text: Exchange rates are locked for 30 minutes from checkout initiation. Orders not completed in that window are re-priced at the current market rate.

title: Late Payment Penalty
text: Invoices overdue by more than 15 days accrue a 1.5 percent monthly late fee applied to the outstanding principal.

title: Payment Grace Period
text: A five-business-day grace period is granted for the first late payment in a 12-month period before late fees are assessed.

title: Expense Reimbursement
text: Employee expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense date and require manager approval above 500 USD.

title: Expense Categories
text: Allowable expense categories include travel, accommodation, meals up to 75 USD per diem, and software subscriptions under 200 USD per month.

title: GDPR Data Subject Rights
text: Data subjects may request erasure of personal data within 30 days of the request. The controller must acknowledge within 72 hours.

title: Right to Portability
text: Personal data must be provided in machine-readable format on request, and the export must be completed within 30 days.

title: Cookie Consent
text: Non-essential cookies require explicit opt-in consent before placement. Consent banners must present options with equal prominence.

title: Consent Withdrawal
text: Users must be able to withdraw cookie consent at any time through the same mechanism used to grant it.

title: Breach Notification
text: Personal data breaches affecting EU residents must be reported to the supervisory authority within 72 hours of discovery.

title: Affected Individual Notification
text: When a breach is likely to result in high risk to individuals, those individuals must be notified without undue delay.

title: Data Processing Agreements
text: All third-party processors must sign a data processing agreement before receiving any personal data from the controller.

title: Processor Obligations
text: Data processors are prohibited from sub-processing personal data without prior written authorisation from the controller.

title: Cross-Border Transfers
text: Personal data may only be transferred outside the EEA under an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses, or binding corporate rules.

title: Transfer Impact Assessment
text: A transfer impact assessment must be conducted before relying on standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfers.

title: Loyalty Points
text: Customers earn one loyalty point per dollar spent. Points expire after 12 months of account inactivity and cannot be redeemed for cash.

title: Loyalty Redemption
text: Loyalty points can be redeemed at checkout at a rate of 100 points per 1 USD discount, subject to a minimum order value of 20 USD.

title: Flash Sale Terms
text: Flash sale prices apply only for the advertised duration and cannot be honoured retroactively for orders placed before or after the window.

title: Price Match Policy
text: Price matching is available for identical items sold by authorised retailers within 7 days of purchase, excluding marketplace third-party sellers.

title: Pre-Order Terms
text: Pre-ordered items are charged at the time of order placement. If the final price is lower at release, the difference is automatically refunded.

title: Pre-Order Cancellation
text: Pre-orders may be cancelled without penalty up to 48 hours before the scheduled ship date.

title: Subscription Box Policy
text: Subscription box contents vary monthly. Customers may skip a month with at least 5 days notice before the next billing date.

title: Subscription Cancellation
text: Subscription cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. Partial-month refunds are not provided.

title: Marketplace Seller Policy
text: Third-party marketplace sellers are responsible for their own return and refund policies, which may differ from the platform's standard policy.

title: Marketplace Dispute Resolution
text: Platform-mediated disputes with marketplace sellers must be initiated within 60 days of delivery and are resolved within 15 business days.

title: Adaptive Prefetch Depth
text: The adaptive prefetch policy adjusts the look-ahead depth based on observed cache hit rates, increasing depth when hit rates fall below the target threshold.

title: Prefetch Backoff
text: When prefetched objects are repeatedly not accessed, the adaptive policy applies exponential backoff to prefetch depth to reduce unnecessary I/O.

title: Session Prefetch Policy
text: The session prefetch policy groups requests by session ID and prefetches KV blocks from the same session that were most recently evicted.

title: Session Prefetch Limits
text: Session prefetch is capped at a configurable max_prefetch_objects limit to prevent a single active session from monopolising I/O bandwidth.

title: Workflow-Aware Eviction
text: The workflow-aware eviction policy inspects the agent step graph and delays eviction of blocks that are referenced by pending or running workflow steps.

title: Eviction Priority Scoring
text: Each candidate block is scored by combining recency, reference count, and predicted reuse probability. The block with the lowest score is evicted first.

title: Multi-Tier Object Store
text: The three-tier hierarchy places GPU HBM at L1, CPU RAM or NVMe at L2, and S3-compatible object storage at L3, with explicit promotion and demotion paths between tiers.

title: Tier Promotion Policy
text: Objects are promoted from L3 to L2 on access and from L2 to L1 when the LLM scheduler assigns the associated sequence to a GPU batch.

title: Workflow Trace Storage
text: Complete workflow traces are stored in L3 after workflow completion and can be retrieved for debugging, auditing, and policy improvement.

title: Trace Compression
text: Workflow traces are compressed using zstd before upload to reduce storage cost. Compression ratio typically ranges from 3x to 8x for structured JSON traces.

title: Clinical Trial Data Retention
text: Clinical trial data must be retained for at least 15 years after study completion under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 regulations.

title: Electronic Records Integrity
text: Electronic records in clinical systems must have audit trails capturing every modification with user identity, timestamp, and reason for change.

title: Informed Consent Storage
text: Signed informed consent documents must be stored in a secure document management system with access logging for the duration of the retention period.

title: Consent Withdrawal Protocol
text: When a participant withdraws consent, data collection ceases immediately, but previously collected data may be retained as permitted by the original consent form.

title: Adverse Event Reporting
text: Serious adverse events must be reported to the IRB within 5 business days of the investigator becoming aware of the event.

title: SUSAR Reporting
text: Suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions must be reported to regulatory authorities within 7 days for fatal or life-threatening events.

title: Force Majeure Clause
text: Neither party is liable for delays caused by events outside reasonable control, including natural disasters, government actions, or infrastructure outages.

title: Force Majeure Notice
text: A party claiming force majeure must notify the other party in writing within 5 business days of the triggering event.

title: Limitation of Liability
text: The aggregate liability of either party under this agreement is limited to the fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim.

title: Consequential Damages Waiver
text: Neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages regardless of whether advised of the possibility of such damages.

title: Arbitration Clause
text: All disputes arising from this agreement shall be resolved by binding arbitration under JAMS rules in San Francisco, California.

title: Class Action Waiver
text: Both parties waive the right to participate in class action lawsuits or class-wide arbitration related to this agreement.

title: Intellectual Property Assignment
text: Work product created by contractors under this agreement is assigned to the company upon creation and does not require a separate assignment document.

title: IP Carve-Out
text: Pre-existing IP and open-source components used in deliverables remain the property of the contractor unless explicitly transferred in writing.

title: Non-Solicitation
text: For 12 months after termination, neither party may solicit or hire the other's employees who were materially involved in performing this agreement.

title: Non-Compete Scope
text: Non-compete obligations are limited to the specific product category described in Schedule A and do not apply to adjacent markets.

title: Monitoring and Alerting
text: Cache hit rate, eviction rate, and prefetch accuracy metrics are exported to Prometheus and can trigger PagerDuty alerts when thresholds are breached.

title: SLO Definitions
text: The system SLO targets p99 latency below 200ms for L2 hits and below 800ms for L3 hits, measured over a rolling 5-minute window.

title: Capacity Planning
text: Storage tier sizing is based on the working set size, which is the 90th percentile of distinct object bytes accessed within a one-hour window.

title: Auto-Scaling Triggers
text: L3 storage capacity auto-scales when utilisation exceeds 80 percent for three consecutive five-minute periods. Scale-in requires 30 minutes below 40 percent.
